rot.corte.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the pawn is on b7, with your king in front of it. But the black king is glued to it, on d8: it takes c7 and c8 from your king, and the black rook takes a7 and a8.
rot.corte.ideia.ex1.e2: Your king has no move. The plan, before the bridge, is to cut off the black king: put the rook on a file between it and the pawn, so it cannot come back. A check on its file does that.
rot.corte.ideia.ex1.l1: Check on the black king's file. Your king watches c7 and c8, and blocking on d2 loses the rook: the black king goes to the e-file.
rot.corte.ideia.ex1.l2: The most stubborn defence: on e8, your king would step out at once via c7. Now the black king is cut off, and the rook on d1 shuts the d-file.
rot.corte.ideia.ex1.l3: With the black king cut off, this is the position from the previous chapter, the Lucena position. The rook goes to the fourth rank to build the bridge, and your king steps out via c7.
rot.corte.demos.outroLado.1: Attack demonstration: now the black king is glued to the other side, on c8, and the black rook watches f7 and f8. Your king is trapped again. Which check cuts the king off?
rot.corte.demos.outroLado.2: The check comes from the side where the black king stands, on its file. It steps to the b-file, and the rook stays between it and the pawn.
rot.corte.demos.outroLado.3: The most stubborn defence. The black king is cut off along the c-file, and d7 and d8 are now free for your king.
rot.corte.demos.outroLado.4: Before the king steps out, the rook goes to the fourth rank. This is the Lucena position, and the bridge comes next.
rot.corte.demos.afogar.1: Defence demonstration: now let us think from Black's side. In the starting position, White put the rook on a1, attacking the black rook, instead of the check. What resource does Black have?
rot.corte.demos.afogar.2: The black rook captures the white one, the only move that saves the game: the white king has no square, and the pawn is blocked. Stalemate, a draw. With the king trapped, trading rooks stalemates.
rot.corte.pratica.coluna.p: Attack: White again, now with the pawn on g7 and the black king glued to it on e8. Cut the king off, build the bridge and promote the pawn.
rot.corte.pratica.coluna.fim: Pawn promoted. First the check on the black king's file, which cuts it off; then the rook on the fourth rank and the bridge.
rot.corte.pratica.outro.p: Attack: the black king is glued to the other side, on b8, and the black rook watches the e-file. Take the pawn to promotion.
rot.corte.pratica.outro.fim: End of the chapter: with the black king glued to the pawn, a check on its file cuts it off, and the bridge takes the pawn to promotion.
rot.corte.pratica.fins.afogado: Stalemate: the side to move had no move, and it is a draw. While your king is trapped, do not offer the rook trade.
rot.corte.pratica.fins.repeticao: The same position occurred three times: a draw. Cut the black king off with a check on its file; then bring the rook to the fourth rank before moving your king out, and build the bridge.
rot.corte.pratica.fins.limite: The move limit ran out before promotion. The road is short: the check that cuts the king off, the rook on the fourth rank and the bridge.
rot.corte.pratica.fins.capturado: The pawn was captured, and without it there is no win. Your king stays near the pawn, and the rook shuts out the checks with the bridge.
rot.corte.pratica.err.afoga.1: Your rook is captured, and your king has no square, with the pawn blocked: stalemate, a draw.
rot.corte.pratica.err.afoga.2: While your king is trapped in front of the pawn, do not give up the rook: once captured, it leaves your king without a move.
rot.corte.pratica.err.solta.1: The black rook captures your rook, which was left unprotected: without it, the win slips away.
rot.corte.pratica.err.solta.2: Before each rook move, check whether the new square is on the black rook's line.
rot.corte.pratica.err.soltaRei.1: The black king captures your rook, which was left next to it unprotected: without it, the win slips away.
rot.corte.pratica.err.soltaRei.2: Keep the rook away from the black king, or protected by your king.
rot.corte.pratica.err.coroa.1: The new piece is captured by the black rook, and without the pawn there is no win.
rot.corte.pratica.err.coroa.2: Promote only when the promotion square is out of the black rook's reach.
rot.corte.pratica.err.peao.1: Your king steps away from the pawn, and the black rook captures it: without the pawn, there is no win.
rot.corte.pratica.err.peao.2: The king stays next to the pawn until it promotes; the black rook's checks are shut out with your rook.
